This page presents the learned representations from the ALIGATEHR-Gen model and its quantitative performance against baselines. Explore the patient and ICD code embedding spaces, and compare evaluation metrics across diseases.

## Patient Embeddings — Coloured by Sex

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

patientData = {
  const text = await FileAttachment("data/patient_embeddings.csv").text();
  return d3.csvParse(text, d3.autoType);
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

createScatterplot = (await import("https://esm.sh/regl-scatterplot@1.9.1")).default
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

import { createPatientWalkthrough } from "./patient-embedding-walkthrough.js"
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

umapSex = {
  const median = values => {
    const sorted = [...values].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const mid = Math.floor(sorted.length / 2);
    return sorted.length % 2 ? sorted[mid] : (sorted[mid - 1] + sorted[mid]) / 2;
  };
  const buildGroup = (label, color, predicate) => {
    const indices = [];
    const ages = [];
    patientData.forEach((d, i) => {
      if (predicate(d)) { indices.push(i); ages.push(d.age); }
    });
    return {
      label,
      color,
      indices,
      stats: [
        ["Median age", `${median(ages)} years`],
        ["Age range", `${Math.min(...ages)}–${Math.max(...ages)} years`],
      ],
    };
  };
  return createPatientWalkthrough({
    data: patientData,
    xField: "umap_1",
    yField: "umap_2",
    title: "Patient Embeddings — Coloured by Sex",
    subtitle: "Pre-trained EHR Encoder · UMAP view",
    datasetLabel: `UKB ${patientData.length.toLocaleString()} patients`,
    kicker: "Sex group spotlight",
    createScatterplot,
    groups: [
      buildGroup("Female", "#e07b39", d => d.sex_male === 0),
      buildGroup("Male", "#4a90d9", d => d.sex_male === 1),
    ],
    tooltip: d => `<strong>ID: ${d.id}</strong><br>Age: ${d.age} · Sex: ${d.sex_male === 1 ? "Male" : "Female"}`,
  });
}
```

## Patient Embeddings — Coloured by Age

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

umapAge = {
  // Age is continuous, so the walkthrough steps through quartile age bands
  // (young → old), each highlighted in a viridis stop.
  const bandColors = ["#440154", "#31688e", "#35b779", "#fde725"];
  const bandNames = ["Youngest quartile", "Lower-middle quartile", "Upper-middle quartile", "Oldest quartile"];
  const sortedAges = patientData.map(d => d.age).sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const quantile = q => sortedAges[Math.min(sortedAges.length - 1, Math.floor(q * sortedAges.length))];
  const cuts = [quantile(0.25), quantile(0.5), quantile(0.75)];
  const bandOf = age => {
    if (age <= cuts[0]) return 0;
    if (age <= cuts[1]) return 1;
    if (age <= cuts[2]) return 2;
    return 3;
  };

  const groups = bandColors.map((color, band) => {
    const indices = [];
    const ages = [];
    patientData.forEach((d, i) => {
      if (bandOf(d.age) === band) { indices.push(i); ages.push(d.age); }
    });
    const lo = Math.min(...ages);
    const hi = Math.max(...ages);
    return {
      label: `${bandNames[band]} · ${lo}–${hi} yrs`,
      color,
      indices,
      stats: [["Age range", `${lo}–${hi} years`]],
    };
  });

  return createPatientWalkthrough({
    data: patientData,
    xField: "umap_1",
    yField: "umap_2",
    title: "Patient Embeddings — Coloured by Age",
    subtitle: "Pre-trained EHR Encoder · UMAP view",
    datasetLabel: `UKB ${patientData.length.toLocaleString()} patients`,
    kicker: "Age band spotlight",
    createScatterplot,
    groups,
    tooltip: d => `<strong>ID: ${d.id}</strong><br>Age: ${d.age} · Sex: ${d.sex_male === 1 ? "Male" : "Female"}`,
  });
}
```

## ICD-10 Code Embedding UMAP {#icd-embedding}

Use the chatbot to request a reviewed ICD Keyword Match, or search the tracked code nodes directly below. Keyword actions are navigation-only and remain separate from Demo Profile comparison.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

import { createIcdKeywordScatter } from "./icd-keyword-scatter.js"
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

icdData = {
  const text = await FileAttachment("data/icd_code_embeddings.csv").text();
  return d3.csvParse(text, d3.autoType);
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

viewof icdSearch = Inputs.text({ label: "Search ICD code or description", placeholder: "e.g. E11, diabetes, circulatory..." })
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

icdUmap = {
  const query = icdSearch.toLowerCase().trim();
  const schemeCategory20 = [
    "#1f77b4","#ff7f0e","#2ca02c","#d62728","#9467bd",
    "#8c564b","#e377c2","#7f7f7f","#bcbd22","#17becf",
    "#aec7e8","#ffbb78","#98df8a","#ff9896","#c5b0d5",
    "#c49c94","#f7b6d2","#c7c7c7","#dbdb8d","#9edae5"
  ];
  let removeRequestListener = () => {};
  let chart = null;
  invalidation.then(() => {
    removeRequestListener();
    if (chart) chart.icdKeywordWalkthrough.destroy();
  });

  let helper = window.ALIGATEHR_ICD_KEYWORD;
  for (let attempt = 0; !helper && attempt < 20; attempt += 1) {
    await new Promise(resolve => window.setTimeout(resolve, 50));
    helper = window.ALIGATEHR_ICD_KEYWORD;
  }
  if (!helper) throw new Error("The ICD visualization request helper is unavailable.");

  const consumed = helper.consumeRequest(sessionStorage);
  chart = await createIcdKeywordScatter({
    data: icdData,
    createScatterplot,
    colors: schemeCategory20,
    searchQuery: query,
    request: consumed.request,
    autoplay: consumed.should_play,
  });
  removeRequestListener = helper.connectRequestConsumer(
    window,
    sessionStorage,
    request => chart.icdKeywordWalkthrough.focus(request),
  );
  window.__ALIGATEHR_ICD_READY__ = true;
  return chart;
}
```

## Evaluation Metrics Comparison

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

evalData = {
  const text = await FileAttachment("data/evaluation_metrics.csv").text();
  return d3.csvParse(text, d3.autoType);
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

viewof selectedMetric = Inputs.select(
  [...new Set(evalData.map(d => d.metric))],
  { label: "Metric", value: "AUROC" }
)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

evalChart = {
  const filtered = evalData.filter(d => d.metric === selectedMetric);
  const diseases = [...new Set(filtered.map(d => d.disease))];
  const models = [...new Set(filtered.map(d => d.model))];

  // Sort diseases by proposed model performance (descending)
  const proposed = filtered.filter(d => d.is_proposed);
  diseases.sort((a, b) => {
    const va = proposed.find(d => d.disease === a)?.value || 0;
    const vb = proposed.find(d => d.disease === b)?.value || 0;
    return vb - va;
  });

  const proposedModel = "ALIGATEHR-Gen";
  const grayScale = ["#888","#aaa","#666","#999","#bbb","#777","#ccc","#555","#ddd"];
  const modelColors = {};
  let gi = 0;
  for (const m of models) {
    modelColors[m] = m === proposedModel ? "#2c5aa0" : grayScale[gi++ % grayScale.length];
  }

  const chart = Plot.plot({
    width: 1000,
    height: 420,
    marginLeft: 180,
    marginRight: 20,
    x: { label: selectedMetric, grid: true },
    y: { label: null, domain: diseases },
    color: { legend: true },
    marks: [
      // Error bars (if CI available)
      Plot.ruleX(filtered.filter(d => d.ci_lower != null && d.ci_upper != null), {
        x1: "ci_lower",
        x2: "ci_upper",
        y: "disease",
        stroke: d => modelColors[d.model],
        strokeWidth: 1.5,
        strokeOpacity: 0.5,
      }),
      // Dots
      Plot.dot(filtered, {
        x: "value",
        y: "disease",
        fill: d => modelColors[d.model],
        r: d => d.model === proposedModel ? 6 : 4,
        symbol: d => d.model === proposedModel ? "circle" : "diamond2",
        tip: true,
        title: d => `${d.model}\n${d.disease}\n${selectedMetric}: ${d.value.toFixed(4)}${d.ci_lower != null ? `\nCI: [${d.ci_lower.toFixed(4)}, ${d.ci_upper.toFixed(4)}]` : ""}`,
      }),
    ],
  });

  // Wrap with title
  const container = document.createElement("div");
  const titleDiv = document.createElement("div");
  titleDiv.innerHTML = `<strong style="font-size:1.1rem;color:#2c3e50;">Model Performance Comparison</strong><br><span style="font-size:0.9rem;color:#6c757d;">${models.length} models × ${diseases.length} diseases · Metric: ${selectedMetric}</span>`;
  titleDiv.style.marginBottom = "8px";
  container.appendChild(titleDiv);
  container.appendChild(chart);

  // Custom legend
  const legendDiv = document.createElement("div");
  legendDiv.style.cssText = "margin-top:8px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;font-family:'Source Sans Pro',sans-serif;font-size:0.85rem;";
  for (const m of models) {
    const color = modelColors[m];
    const shape = m === proposedModel ? "●" : "◆";
    const weight = m === proposedModel ? "font-weight:600;" : "";
    legendDiv.innerHTML += `<span style="${weight}"><span style="color:${color};margin-right:3px;">${shape}</span>${m}</span>`;
  }
  container.appendChild(legendDiv);

  return container;
}
```
